Introduction

Choi Jungeun is a South Korean singer and dancer under WAKEONE.

Prior to debuting,she participated in the Mnet's 2020 survival show "CAP-TEEN", but was sadly eliminated. In 2024, she was a contestant on Mnet's survival show I-LAND2: N/a, where she ended up ranking 1st place in the final with 823,393 votes, thus securing her spot as a member of the final group, izna.

She made her debut with the group on November 25, 2024, with the release of their first mini album titled "N/a".
